newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 652-658 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 652-658 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 652-658 per dollar, virtually unchanged from the morning's 650-660 but down from the previous close at 635-640 due to the longer value date of spot deals, dealers said.
"The lev held steady throughout the day as interbank dollar demand and supply were balanced in a lively trade," a dealer said.
The lev's fall was solely due to the longer value date of spot-deals, traders said.
The current large spread between interest rates on lev- and dollar-denominated deposits allows for a daily dollar rise by two to three levs, traders said.
The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) central interest rate is now set at 15.0 percent monthly or 180.0 percent annually.
The BNB was not seen buying dollars on Wednesday, dealers said. BNB officials were not available for comment. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
